channel.title: Semiconductors: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the semiconductors sector.

item.title: Iste: IST signed a KRW 1.96bn contract to sell semiconductor FOUP Cleaner equipment to Amkor Technology Arizona, Inc.
Protec: Protec signed a KRW 23.41bn semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply contract with Samsung Electronics, equal to 10.2% of recent revenue.
Asicland: Asicland signed a KRW 13.9bn contract to supply mass-produced custom semiconductors in Korea, equal to 19.1% of recent revenue.
Imagis: Imagis won a KRW 6.58bn laptop touch IC order from Cirque Corporation, equal to 49.75% of recent revenue.
Imagis: Imagis' market capitalization has been below KRW 20bn for 25 consecutive trading days as of Nov 18, 2026, risking administrative issue designation.
meerecompany: meerecompanyIncorporated signed a KRW 2.09bn semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply contract with Samsung Electronics, equal to 5.11% of recent revenue.
Tesco: TES signed a KRW 48.08bn semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply contract with SK hynix, 13.69% of recent revenue.
meerecompany: Mirae Company signed a KRW 4.8bn semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply contract with Samsung Electronics, equal to 11.74% of recent revenue.
Fadu: FADU signed a KRW 20.4bn enterprise SSD controller supply contract with an overseas NAND flash maker, 22.05% of revenue.
Kga: KGA signed a KRW 2.8bn logistics automation equipment supply contract, equal to 15.45% of recent revenue, with delivery through July 31, 2027.
Shinsung E&G: Shinsung E&G reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 158.4bn and operating profit of KRW 0.6bn.
Duksanhimetalco: Duksan Hi-Metal reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 99.5bn, up 61.9% year on year, with operating profit of KRW 10.2bn.
HB Solution: HB Solution signed a KRW 15.6bn equipment supply contract with Chengdu BOE Display Technology for delivery in China.
